title: Centre Extends ED Director Rahul Navin’s Tenure

blocks.content: The Appointments Committee of the Cabinet approved a one-year extension for Enforcement Directorate Director Rahul Navin on 8 August 2026. The extension allows him to continue as head of the central financial investigation agency until 13 August 2027, or until further orders.

items: The Appointments Committee of the Cabinet is the authority that approves senior appointments in the Union Government.
The Department of Personnel & Training issues orders related to appointments and service matters for central government officers.
The Financial Action Task Force is an inter-governmental body that sets standards on anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing.
The Enforcement Directorate is one of India’s key economic intelligence and investigation agencies.
